title: fragaria vesca subvar. monophylla
intro: Fragaria vesca subvar. monophylla, commonly known as the alpine strawberry, is a type of strawberry plant that is native to high-altitude regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria vesca subvar. monophylla include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic agent, due in part to its bioactive constituents, which include ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to have various health benefits, including anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects, making Fragaria vesca subvar. monophylla a plant of interest for further research and potential therapeutic applications.
